# Quikpik

Quikpik is a B2B wholesale platform that helps wholesalers manage products, orders, invoices, inventory, customers, and marketing.

## Public pages

- Homepage: https://quikpik.app/
- Blog (QuikTips & Insights): https://quikpik.app/blog
- Terms of Service: https://quikpik.app/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://quikpik.app/privacy

## Dynamic public content

- Wholesaler storefronts: https://quikpik.app/w/{slug}
- Public product pages: https://quikpik.app/product/{slug}
- Wholesaler welcome pages: https://quikpik.app/welcome/{id}

## Sitemap

https://quikpik.app/sitemap.xml
